tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. The default ground for every section except the contact finale.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Raised ground: project cards, nav when scrolled, code blocks.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Recessed ground: project media frames, tag fills, input wells.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px dividers between principle rows, experience rows and footer columns. Decorative only; never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edges that carry meaning: ghost button outline, input borders. 3:1+ on paper, surface and surface-sunk in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and display headlines on paper, surface and surface-sunk.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: body under headlines, card summaries, meta lines. 6.7:1+ on paper, surface and surface-sunk in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Large text only (24px+): oversized index numerals, the second line of a display headline. 3.4:1 on paper in Daylight, so never for body copy.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Cobalt, the one brand hue. Links, primary button fill, revealed statement text, principle titles. Text-safe on paper, surface and accent-tint in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state for accent links and the primary button.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet cobalt ground: the offset panel behind project media, hover fill on nav links, selected tag.

tokens.name: accent-veil
tokens.usage: Pre-reveal state of RevealStatement words only. Not a text color at rest: with reduced motion every word shows in accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent or accent-strong fill. Never hard-code white: in Night the cobalt lightens and takes dark text.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Ember orange, the 'live' mark: the availability dot, the cursor caret, the cover's small block. Always beside a text label, never a fill under text.

tokens.name: signal-ink
tokens.usage: Signal as text: the 'Now' label and availability text on paper and surface.

tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: Ground of the contact finale and footer in both themes: the page ends in the dark.

tokens.name: night-ink
tokens.usage: Headlines and body on night.

tokens.name: night-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and the ghost button outline on night.

tokens.name: glow-cobalt
tokens.usage: Radial glow on night, lower left of the finale. Background light only, never text.

tokens.name: glow-teal
tokens.usage: Radial glow on night, upper right of the finale, paired with glow-cobalt. Background light only.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. 6.4:1+ on paper, surface and surface-sunk in both themes.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The hero headline, once per page. 48px under 720px wide.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Section titles and the finale headline. 40px under 720px.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Principle titles, project titles on case-study pages.

styles.name: statement
styles.sample: Most software still runs on yesterday's assumptions.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Senior engineer in Toronto building payments infrastructure and AI-native workflows.
styles.usage: Hero subline, lead paragraphs, finale copy.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Designed the retry and reconciliation path before the happy path.
styles.usage: Default copy: card summaries, principle descriptions, case-study prose.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Built with Astro. Hosted on my own domain.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows, nav links, button text, section indices. Always uppercase (text-transform), never sentence case.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Lowercase metadata rows: tags, card meta, timestamps.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Inline and block code in case studies.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, tag inner vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps inside a meta row, between tags.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Offset of the accent-tint panel behind project media; label-to-heading gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Dot-grid pitch; button horizontal padding; mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, grid gutter, desktop page gutter.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Heading-to-body gap in sections; principle row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gap between project cards; between section title and content.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding under 720px.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Hero top padding below the nav.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop. Sections breathe: never less than this between major sections above 720px.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Buttons. Crisp, nearly square: the system's controls are precise, not bubbly.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Small surfaces: code blocks, inputs, the nav pill when scrolled.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Large media: project frames and their offset panel. The one soft shape on the page.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Tags and the availability chip.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Project cards on hover and the scrolled nav. Nothing else casts a shadow.
